text: It is completely understandable that you feel hurt. When you open up about your feelings and expect a certain level of care or validation, having those feelings brushed off can feel like a rejection of the friendship itself. It makes sense that you would feel a sense of disappointment, especially when you valued the closeness you thought you shared with them.
